title.ja: 図1-1 初手から5筋の歩を突く
title.en: Figure 1-1: Push the 5th-file pawn from the first move

explain.ja: 先手番の中飛車は、初手にいきなり▲5六歩と突くのが指し方です。ここから、相手が飛車先を突いてきた場合と、角道を開けてきた場合の駒組みを、それぞれ見ていきます。5筋の歩を突くので、相手には中飛車の作戦が初めから分かってしまい、対策を持たれていると指しにくくなるのが難点です。
explain.en: As Black, the way to play Central Rook is to push ▲5六歩 on the very first move. From here we will look at the setups when the opponent pushes the rook-file pawn and when the opponent opens the bishop diagonal. A drawback is that pushing the 5th-file pawn reveals the Central Rook plan from the start, so it is harder to play if the opponent has a prepared counter.

section.ja: 初手はいきなり▲5六歩と突く!

title.ja: 図a-1 ▲7六歩から駒組みすると…？
title.en: Figure a-1: What if the formation starts with ▲7六歩...?

explain.ja: ▲5六歩を急がず、先に▲7六歩と突くのが自然な駒組みに見えますが、実はうまくいきません。図a-1のように▲7六歩、△3四歩、▲5六歩と進んだ局面では、後手からいきなり仕掛けがあります。
explain.en: Playing ▲7六歩 first instead of rushing ▲5六歩 seems like a natural setup, but it does not work well. In the position after ▲7六歩, △3四歩, ▲5六歩, White has an immediate attack.

section.ja: 初手はいきなり▲5六歩と突く!

title.ja: 図a-2 いきなり馬を作られる
title.en: Figure a-2: A horse is made right away

explain.ja: 後手は角交換から△5七角と打って、いきなり馬を作ってしまい、先手は指しにくい展開になります。なお、この手順は先手と後手を入れ替えると成り立たないのがポイントです。
explain.en: White exchanges bishops and drops the bishop with △5七角, making a horse right away, and Black ends up with a difficult game. Note that this sequence does not work if the roles of Black and White are reversed.

section.ja: 初手はいきなり▲5六歩と突く!

title.ja: 図a-3 切り返しの角打ち

explain.ja: 先手と後手が逆なら、ここで自陣に角を打つ切り返しが可能です。ただし今回は相手が飛車先の歩を突いているため、▲8六角と引く手がない点が重要です。
explain.en: If the sides were reversed, you could answer by dropping a bishop in your own camp. Here, though, the opponent has pushed the rook-file pawn, so there is no retreat with ▲8六角, and that is the key point.

section.ja: 初手はいきなり▲5六歩と突く!

explain.ja: 図1-1から相手が△8四歩と飛車先の歩を突いてきたら、▲7六歩と突いて角道を開けます。
explain.en: From the diagram, if the opponent pushes the rook pawn with △8四歩, open your bishop line with ▲7六歩.

title.ja: 図2-2 角で相手の飛車から守る
title.en: Figure 2-2: Defend with the bishop against the opponent's rook

explain.ja: 相手がさらに飛車先を伸ばしてきたら、▲7七角と上がります。これで次の△8六歩という攻めを防げます。角で相手の飛車からの攻めを守る形です。
explain.en: If the opponent extends the rook pawn further, play ▲7七角. This stops the follow-up attack with △8六歩, so the bishop is defending against the opposing rook's attack.

title.ja: 図2-3 ▲5五歩で角のラインを止める
title.en: Figure 2-3: Stop the bishop's line with ▲5五歩

explain.ja: 相手が△3四歩と角道を通してきたら、▲5五歩と突いて自分の角道を閉じます。角交換に応じないのが振り飛車の基本です。角は相手の飛車からの攻めを守る駒なので、簡単には交換しないようにしましょう。
explain.en: If the opponent opens their bishop line with △3四歩, close your own bishop line with ▲5五歩. Declining the bishop exchange is basic Ranging Rook play, because the bishop defends against the opposing rook's attack and should not be traded lightly.

section.ja: ▲5五歩で角のラインを止めよう!
section.en: Block the bishop line with ▲5五歩!

title.ja: 図2-4 ゴキゲン中飛車の形と合流
title.en: Figure 2-4: Merge with the Gokigen Central Rook form

explain.ja: 最後に飛車を5筋に振れば、ゴキゲン中飛車の形に合流します。先手番で指している分、1手得をしています。
explain.en: Finally, swing the rook to the fifth file and the position joins the Gokigen Central Rook (Ranging Rook) setup. Because you are playing as Black, you are a tempo ahead.

section.ja: ▲5五歩で角のラインを止めよう!
section.en: Block the bishop line with ▲5五歩!

explain.ja: 相手が2手目に△3四歩と角道を開けてきたら、▲5八飛と飛車を5筋に回るのが基本です。▲7六歩と角道を開ける前に飛車を5筋に回しておくと、角交換から△5七角と打ち込まれる隙がなくなります。5七への角の打ち込みは常に警戒しましょう。
explain.en: If the opponent opens their bishop line with △3四歩 on move two, the standard reply is to swing the rook with ▲5八飛. Moving the rook to the fifth file before opening your bishop line with ▲7六歩 removes the weakness of a bishop exchange followed by a bishop drop at 5七 (△5七角). Always watch out for that drop.

title.ja: 図3-2 ▲5五歩と角道を閉じてから▲7六歩
title.en: Figure 3-2: Close the bishop diagonal with ▲5五歩, then ▲7六歩

explain.ja: ここでも▲7六歩と角道を開けたいところですが、先に▲5五歩と突いて角道を閉じてから▲7六歩とします。図3-2から相手がいきなり△8六歩と開戦してきた場合は、超急戦の形に合流します。
explain.en: You would like to open the bishop line with ▲7六歩 here too, but first close the bishop line with ▲5五歩 and then play ▲7六歩. If the opponent starts the fight at once with △8六歩 from the next diagram, the game joins the Chokyusen (super-fast attack) lines.

section.ja: ▲5五歩で角のラインを止めてから、安全に角道を開ける
section.en: Block the bishop line with ▲5五歩, then safely open the bishop diagonal

title.ja: 図3-3 ゴキゲン中飛車の形に合流
title.en: Figure 3-3: Merge into the Gokigen Central Rook form

explain.ja: 最後に▲7七角と上がって相手の飛車先の歩の交換を防げば、ゴキゲン中飛車の形に合流します。駒組みが終わった後の指し方は別の記事で解説しています。
explain.en: Finally, play ▲7七角 to prevent the opponent from exchanging pawns on the rook file, and the position joins the Gokigen Central Rook setup. How to play after the setup is covered in other articles.

section.ja: ▲5五歩で角のラインを止めてから、安全に角道を開ける
section.en: Block the bishop line with ▲5五歩, then safely open the bishop diagonal
